prereg.primary_metric: search nodes to first verified solution
prereg.analysis: paired per-task ratios vs P0; median + bootstrap 95% CI (5000 resamples, fixed seed); pooled across master seeds; per-seed medians reported and must fall on the same side of 1.0 as the pooled verdict

gates.ADMIT_nodes: wA held-out pooled: median(P3/P0 nodes) <= 0.5, CI95 upper < 1.0
gates.ADMIT_correctness: every arm solves and verifies 100% of tasks
gates.ADMIT_ablation: P3 with the concept removed is counter-identical to P0 on the first 10 held tasks of every seed
gates.TRANSFER_nodes: wB pooled: median(P3/P0 nodes) <= 0.5, CI95 upper < 1.0, concept hash unchanged from admission (frozen, no retuning)
gates.TRANSFER_ablation: concept removal restores P0 counter-identically on 10 tasks/seed on wB
gates.NEG_hostile: wC hostile blind: median(P3/P0 nodes) >= 1.5, CI95 lower > 1.0
gates.DETECT: c0001 runtime-failure rate >= 0.05 in wC with >= 100 attempts, and exactly 0 runtime failures in wA and wB
gates.REV_guard_oos: guard predicts c0001 runtime failure on 400 fresh wC states per seed with accuracy >= 0.95
gates.REV_failures: P3G reduces c0001 runtime failures >= 90% vs blind P3 on wC validation tasks
gates.REV_cost: median(P3G/P3 execs) <= 1.10 and median(P3G/P3 nodes) <= 1.02 on wC validation

prereg.expected_residual: hostile node harm is task-level (minimal solutions avoid the composition) and is NOT fixable by a state-level guard; it is recorded as the concept's bounded failure region, not hidden

K1_trivial_worlds.note: primitive-only median nodes on wA held-out

K2_short_domain_procedure.note: bidirectional search over inverse primitives solves these tasks in ~1e3 node visits; inverses are excluded from the solver class by design, so every cost claim is relative to the forward-composition solver class. Recorded, not hidden.

K4_no_advantage_over_flat.note: P3 vs P2a and P2b gates

K6_transfer_needed_retuning.note: content hash frozen between admission and transfer

K9_no_live_consumers.note: fraction of wA/wB P3 solutions that actually invoke the concept

K10_storage_vs_computation.note: flat storage (P2a) does not reproduce the reification advantage
